user_query: My company is organizing a charity event for pets. Can you fetch the details of a pet named Bella from the PetstoreRateLimit API and provide me with a new short link using the URL Link Shortener API? Also, fetch a list of available domains from the same API.

TaskList.description: Fetch the details of a pet named Bella from the PetstoreRateLimit API.
Fetch a list of available domains from the PetstoreRateLimit API.
Provide a new short link using the URL Link Shortener API with the details fetched in step 1.
